title: OpenAI Unveils New Scientific Discoveries in Math, Physics and CS
excerpt: OpenAI has announced three new discoveries in math, computer science, and physics, utilizing external academic experts called shepherds.
body_html:
OpenAI has revealed three major discoveries spanning the fields of mathematics, computer science, and physics. This announcement comes less than a month after the organization released numerous manuscripts featuring solutions to longstanding mathematical problems.

For this latest rollout, OpenAI has introduced a new approach to working with academia. The company collaborated with external experts, referred to as "shepherds," who helped guide the research results.
